svg.title: An organisation view for people who are on no team’s board — SoftTrack web design mockup (#282)
svg.desc: Seeing a team’s work takes membership, so the chief executive was made a guest of one team to see anything and saw that team. A flag granted by a site admin to a named person gives read access to every team without membership of any, with a landing page of every team’s sprint, open and overdue work, and no access to money.
svg.text: An organisation view for people who are on no team’s board
· the whole, for whoever answers for the whole
How the company is doing, not how one team is

g.text: /organisation, signed in as Sofia, who is on no team
Every account on this SoftTrack. Accounts are deactivated rather than deleted —
tickets, comments and history all point at them.

svg.text: Done when a site admin can grant and revoke organisation view for a named person, with the grant logged and shown as a chip; the person reads boards, lists, tickets, comments,
sprints, epics and reports of every team and changes none of it; a team’s member list names the organisation viewers who can read it; a landing page lists every team; finance
stays behind its own flag; and a sweep test expects every mutating route to refuse.
